scope: Source/UI only. No actual result/model loaded by author, and no scientific imports, searches, training, native queries or replays.
entry: viewer.js autostarts once DOM is ready and #reader exists. Fetches visual-data.json unless #reader.dataset.visualUrl supplies a URL. To mount supplied data manually, set window.GCTS_GEOMETRY_READER_NO_AUTOSTART=true before script load, then call GCTSGeometryReader.mount(data).
math_renderer: Root supplies established MathJax with typesetPromise; waits for startup.promise and clears earlier typeset state. Only displayed hypotheses/target/selected certificate formulas are converted or typeset, never the complete formula registry. Every mathematical expression uses LaTeX. V4 also supplies inline LaTeX for mathematical identifiers in English explanations; the same existing DOM typesetting path handles these textContent strings.

ast.unknown_tag: Throws explicitly; terms are not accepted as formulas. Function and predicate arguments use the frozen third-field array convention.

data.formula_codes: Exact zero-indexed formula AST registry. Only needed entries are read.
data.recipes: Original ordered recipe array; each recipe has id, primitive_witness and ordered_premise_formulas.
data.scope: Optional root-authored human text rendered using textContent.
data.observations: Original source observations plus root id and independent flags; no inference of success from mode, metrics, decoded word or training status.

observation.attempts: Saved actual attempts; missing means explicitly not supplied
observation.seconds: Original numeric/object time field displayed verbatim
observation.node_count: Original saved node count displayed verbatim
observation.limits: Original source limit object displayed verbatim
observation.point_certificate: null or original decorated placement certificate
observation.decoded_certificate: null or original decoded certificate; local_certificate.proof commands are separately inspectable without guessing their expansion correspondence
observation.independent_certificate_accepted: boolean; only literal true displays root independent certificate acceptance, default pending
observation.independent_trace_accepted: boolean; only literal true displays root independent trace acceptance, default pending
observation.independent_scope: Optional root human text displayed verbatim

identity_preimage.prototype_preimage: Original prototype: recipe_id, primitive_witness, ordered_premise_formulas, relative_ordered_input_offsets, orientation identity, relative t/m supports
identity_preimage.t: Absolute t supports, byte-value correspondence checked for display
identity_preimage.m: Absolute m supports, byte-value correspondence checked for display

display_checks: Sort certificate placements by exact saved row; reject duplicate/negative rows.
Top command/t/m equal identity_preimage counterparts; absolute supports equal shifted prototype supports.
Output mark at (1,row) references formula_codes[code] equal command.formula.
For a complete certificate, each ordered source strictly precedes row and its prior output equals ordered premise.
Relative offsets equal source-row; blue source mark at (1,sourceRow) carries the ordered premise formula code; purple mark at (2+input,currentRow) carries the exact negative offset.
These UI integrity checks are not independent mathematical/native proof checking.
visual: One fixed-orientation physical square per saved placement, sorted by row, with blue output and purple ordered negative-reference layer toggles. Full formula and faithful rule/source-ref English appear beside it. All actual t/m/key/id data remain inspectable.
missing_certificate: Display actual status/metrics/hypotheses/target plus selected saved partial-state square cards, formula constraints and pending receptor labels. No proof rows or certificate are invented. Full exact graph/event remains inspectable.
safety: Native DOM creation and textContent only; no innerHTML, eval, scientific engine, checker or policy import. Fetch is data loading for root-integrated browser only. No dependencies beyond root-established MathJax.
actual_data_qa: Root owns actual terminal data integration, all-six/geometry scientific checks and browser/MathJax QA. This source-only readiness ran synthetic display fixtures only; actual certificate path remains unexercised.
source_correction: The initial root-supplied v1 mark schema was incorrect. Frozen core point_data assigns blue formula constraints at (1,outputRow) and (1,sourceRow), and purple ordered offsets at (2+input,currentRow). V2 corrects display checks; frozen v1 remains history. Current root-reported null certificates do not exercise actual certificate DOM. V3 additionally handles the actual declared exterior negative-row blue sentinel -1; V2 rejected it as an invalid formula code. Frozen V2 is preserved. Author still loads no actual result or model.

snapshot.graph_order: Original complete ordered placement-key array [recipeIndex,row,orderedSources]. At most 24 selected placements; insertion order preserved in details, cards sorted by numeric row.
snapshot.totals: Frozen core uses row-indexed scalar occupancy array: value at row is T(0,row). Explicit [x,y,value] triples also accepted as a separate declared layout; original totals never rewritten.
snapshot.marks: Original [x,y,value,referenceCount] assignments; zero is assigned. All marks appear in colored snapshot point list, including constraints not attached to a selected square.
snapshot.blue_x1: Exact formula_codes[value]. Selected output must match recipe.primitive_witness.formula. Ordered source formula constraints must match recipe.ordered_premise_formulas; unselected numeric prior sources remain pending receptors.
snapshot.purple_x2plus: Exact ordered negative source-row offset at (2+input,currentRow). These are offsets, not formula codes.
snapshot.partial_semantics: Search-state placements and constraints only, never labelled a proof/certificate or reconstructed primitive command. Recipe witness appears only as exact saved data.
checks: exact positive marking reference counts/no duplicate points
every ordered reference strictly prior numerically; need not currently be selected
snapshot.default: Maximal saved graph.order length among initial state, chronological events, terminal state; first tie in that order. This is a deepest saved partial state, not an assumed proof.
snapshot.toggles: Both formula/reference layer toggles redraw selected trace cards and MathJax without changing the chosen event; observation change chooses that observation’s deepest saved state.
snapshot.every_field: Exact selected snapshot graph/hints/event/complete state JSON remains inspectable. No scientific formula/graph is generated by reader.

exterior_blue.condition: Only x=1, row<0, value=-1 is an exterior boundary exclusion sentinel. It is an explicitly assigned literal mark, never a formula code. All other blue formula marks are nonnegative registered codes on nonnegative rows.
exterior_blue.display: Retain every saved exterior assignment and show its exact LaTeX point value and reference count, labelled Exterior boundary exclusion sentinel; never access formula_codes[-1] or translate it as formula English. Sentinels remain visible when formula/reference layers are toggled.
exterior_blue.checks: Reject exterior blue values zero, other negative values, and any interior blue sentinel.

english_notation.variable_and_binder: Inline LaTeX mathit with existing escapeTex inside returned English strings.
english_notation.function_and_predicate_names: Inline LaTeX operatorname with existing escapeTex inside returned English strings.
english_notation.rule_names: Axiom, recipe and unknown rule names use escaped inline text; generalization variable uses escaped inline mathit. UI row numbers and selector/recipe metadata labels remain metadata.
english_notation.dom: All English is assigned by textContent, then included in existing full proof/trace MathJax typeset target. No innerHTML or new scientific interpretation.
english_notation.checks: Nine source-synthetic English controls cover variables, constants, functions, predicates, binders, escaped backslash/braces/underscore/dollar names, axiom/recipe/rule IDs and generalization variable.
